Identification_Area.title: Bundle description for the gbo.ast-apophis.jpl.radar.shape_model bundle

Citation_Information.description: This data set contains a preliminary three-dimensional shape model and spin state of near-Earth asteroid (99942) Apophis based on ground-based radar images as reported by Brozovic et al. (2018). This shape model (apophis_v233s7) is Model B from Figure 6 (and Supplementary Figure 4C) in Brozovic et al. 2018. The rotation state (apophis_v233s7_spin_state) is the same as Model R in the Supplementary Table 1 in Brozovic et al. 2018.
